text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while relaxing at the park…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Nothing like some good R and R to heal the soul.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you look like you're going to slip off into dreamland with that teacup still in hand, Sei.
choice_data_list: What are you both up to?
What are you both up to?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh hey, Trainer. We're just having an outdoor tea ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join us? You needn't worry about following etiquette—just enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We've prepared more than enough treats as well, hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There's nothing like kicking back in nature. Outdoor tea parties are the best.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed. ♪ Now then, shall we begin the ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'm not really into sitting on my knees for the whole time…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All I fancy's a nice nap in the warm sunlight.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, hang on now. I do want some of those sweets, though… They have just the right balance of sweetness—I could eat the whole plate. ♪
choice_data_list: It's hard to stop once you start, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. Sheesh. Hey, as long as I burn the calories later, there's no harm.
choice_data_list: That means you can't skip practice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Urgh…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're quite right. It's crucial to strike a balance between how much we eat and how we exercise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, let's do some running together after this, Sei. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait a second now, is that why you invited my trainer to join us?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… What makes you ask that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's underhanded show of concern pays off, and Seiun Sky ends up exercising to account for the extra calories.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You get it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Scrumptious sweets with the simple yet refined taste of tea make for an unbeatable pair.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We have more than enough to go around, so eat and drink to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! I'm in heaven here! I'm gonna try a little of everything. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky and I stuff ourselves with delicious snacks.
